dslRule:
/*!id: arrays.compare-char-array-content*/
<!description: Replace reference comparison (==) of char arrays with content comparison using Arrays.equals().>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: array, comparison, bugfix>

$arrayElement1 == $arrayElement2 :: instanceof($arrayElement1, "char[]") && instanceof($arrayElement2, "char[]") && hasNoSideEffect($arrayElement1) && hasNoSideEffect($arrayElement2)
=>
java.util.Arrays.equals($arrayElement1, $arrayElement2)
;;
summary: Replaces '==' operator with 'Arrays.equals()' for comparing char[] array elements.
